item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Security forces seized a Kuki-Zo insurgent camp in Manipur, arrested a KNF (MC) cadre and a Kuki militant, and recovered foreign-made firearms, grenades and ammunition, while the Manipur chief minister linked the violence to a pervasive gun culture and urged surrender of illegal arms. The CRPF director general and Assam Rifles chief reviewed Manipur security and held high-level meetings on law and order, calling for peace and joint operations. In Jammu and Kashmir, the lieutenant governor chaired unified command meetings and the IGP called for action against over-ground workers and hybrid terrorists, with arrests for leaking security information to foreign handlers. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
